description.value: Artigiano is a pioneering Vancouver-area specialty coffee chain that has been crafting espresso drinks and artisanal baked goods for over 25 years, earning international barista awards along the way. The Phibbs Exchange location sits at a major North Vancouver transit hub, making it a natural stop for cyclists moving through the area. The chain roasts its own 100% Arabica beans at a Burnaby roastery and prioritizes organic, locally sourced ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Artigiano is a real, actively operating specialty coffee chain with 25+ locations in BC and Alberta, and lists 'Phibbs Exchange' as one of its North Vancouver locations, consistent with the OSM coordinates. OSM tags confirm outdoor seating and provide phone and URL; the website is live and matches the URL but does not list individual location phone numbers, so phone confirmation is null. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are described anywhere in the fetched website content for any individual location.
concerns: OSM name is 'Cafe Artigiano' but the current website branding is 'Artigiano' — the 'Cafe' prefix appears to have been dropped from the brand.
OSM record has no street address, only addr:unit=104 and community North Vancouver; full civic address is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating cafe at a confirmed North Vancouver location; useful stop for touring cyclists at the Phibbs Exchange transit hub.
